title: Speaking — Eating out
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on eating out.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
How do you choose where to eat with friends?
When is a restaurant worth visiting again?

part2.topic: Describe a place where the service made a meal memorable.
part2.closing: and explain how the service affected the experience.

questions: Why can small restaurants offer service large chains find hard to copy?
How do online ratings affect restaurants that have only just opened?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to eating out?
